Name: Sprite for Ohodavis Rasmodia
Author: StoutGoi
Description:
A sprite to match, "Ohodavi's Portrait for Romanceable Rasmodia." There's only a with-hat option, and I don't intend to make a no-hat option. These sprites are based on an older version of Romanceable Rasmodia, I am very slow at doing these sorts of things, so I haven't decided if I'll update it for the newer versions fo the sprites.

I have not tested this with RRRR and I probably won't. I won't make a version of this for any of the other portraits, although I'd be very grateful to anyone who did. (it could be you! yes, you!)

It's still in beta because I have not done a full playthrough with it, I'll take it out of beta once I have.

It's not an omission, despite being made to match, "Ohodavi's Portrait for Romanceable Rasmodia," it does not require it.

Please make sure to read all the settings in the main Romanceable Rasmodia mod, as you need to set the proper compatibilities for that mod to work so this mod can work.
